answer: Work waits on the nadir until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ripple of the next round. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zephyr of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
